items.label: Second-Skin Stretch Fabric
items.value: Made from a high-stretch blend of 88% Polyester and 12% Spandex. This fabric is lightweight, exceptionally soft, and offers a second-skin feel with comfortable, supportive four-way stretch for ease of movement

items.label: Fashion Off-Shoulder Cut
items.value: Features a Y2K-inspired off-shoulder neckline that can be styled straight across or asymmetrically. The cropped length and body-hugging fit accentuate the waistline, while the boatneck design creates a simple yet statement summer look

items.label: Creates Versatile Stylish Looks
items.value: A core piece for creating layered Y2K-style outfits. Wear it alone with high-waisted jeans, cargo pants, skirts, or biker shorts. It also layers perfectly under sheer shirts, oversized blazers, or denim jackets for added dimension

items.label: Vibrant Summer Occasions
items.value: Designed for casual and social occasions in warm weather. Perfect for summer outings, festivals, parties, beach vacations, travel, shopping, or casual gatherings, adding a fashionable vibe to your leisure time

items.label: Fit & Care Instruction
items.value: Due to the fitted style, please consult the detailed size chart using your bust and waist measurements to ensure the best fit. We recommend gentle hand wash in cold water and laying flat to dry to maintain the fabric’s elasticity and shape

items.value: Off Shoulder Neck, One Shoulder Neck
